prompt: Build a tiny browser game in index.html: a Start button, a target button that adds one point when clicked, a visible text score, and Restart that resets the score. Use plain HTML/CSS/JavaScript, no dependencies or external assets. Make sure it works. Document how to run it.

Create sum.mjs, a Node.js CLI that prints the sum of two integer arguments. For missing or invalid input, print a short error to stderr and exit nonzero without a stack trace. Use no dependencies. Make sure it works and document usage.

Fix clamp(5, 0, 10): it currently returns 10 instead of 5. Add and run a failing regression test before changing the implementation, then fix it and rerun the tests. Preserve existing behavior for values below and above the range.

files.clamp.js: export const clamp = (value, min, max) => Math.max(min, Math.max(max, value));
